text:
(ESA 2023) Rewrite the verbs in parentheses in the correct verb tense (Simple Past or Present Perfect) according to the context.
NON-COMISSIONED OFFICER OF THE YEAR
COMBAT ARMS NCO ACADEMY (ESA), Três Corações - Sergeant Major Rodrigo Pereira Menezes __________ (be) 17 years old when he ________ (decide) to become an NCO. He _______ (join) the Brazilian Army in March 7, 1994. He _______ (be) in the Army for 29 years. Since his graduation, he _______ (serve) in five different states across Brazil. For his exemplary service and impeccable career, the Combat Arms NCO Academy awards SGT MAJ Menezes with the prize NCO of the Year.
options: was - decided - joined - has been - has served
has been - decided - has joined - has been - has served
has been - decided - joined - has been - has served
was - has decided - joined - has been - served
subject: Inglês
explanation:
(A) Cereta. como os comentários a seguir comprovam:

1 - (be) 17 years old when he ...

“when” indica um momento específico no passado.

Regra: Simple Past para idade em situação pontual passada.

was, concordando no singular com o sujeito “Sergeant Major Rodrigo Pereira Menezes”

Exemplo: “I was 10 when I moved here.”

2 - (decide)

Momento concluído no passado.

Regra: quando há uma ação única e terminada, devemos empregar Simple Past.

decided

Exemplo: “He decided to help.”

3 - (join) in March 7, 1994

Quando há Data específica no passado, usamos o Simple Past.

joined

Exemplo: “She joined in 2005.”

4 - (be) in the Army for 29 years

Duração desde o passado até hoje → Present Perfect.

Uso de “for” com período implica o uso do Present Perfect.

has been

Exemplo: “I have been here for 10 years.”
